Splashers

Something under the water hears everything. Swing across the flooded halls to the glowing gate without making a sound.

Move like a gorilla: push your hands against platforms and pillars to shove yourself along. Swing your arms to run, push down hard to jump. Your hands stick to anything they touch. The platforms are separate islands, so launch yourself across the gaps. There are four levels, then a thank-you room.
Trigger throws a pebble to lure the creature away. Stone is silent, so the creature can’t hear you on the platforms. Only the water gives you away: slap it, splash through it, throw a pebble into it, or fall in. The water is shallow, so if you fall in you can wade to a platform and climb back out, but don’t hang around.
Checking for VR…
